content: Gemini free tier (no billing account required) exists per ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits, exact numbers vary by model/tier and are only authoritatively listed in the live AI Studio rate-limit dashboard, not the static docs page. Third-party blog aggregators (not authoritative) report free-tier Flash-Lite variants around 15 RPM / ~1000 RPD as of mid-2026, but these conflict with each other and are LOW confidence; verify against aistudio.google.com/rate-limit at implementation time.
